headline: Weathered Expanse Simmers as Mooring Front Settles
war_summary: Three hours on, the strain eases but remains centred on the Weathered Expanse, which records three changes in the last two hours and 83 in the day, down from ten and ninety-eight, holding at three Warden, two Colonial and four neutral with Wightwalk, Frostmarch and Crow's Nest busiest and day losses of 8,298 Colonial and 11,336 Warden. Mooring County also cools to one change in two hours and 50 in the day, now listed at twelve Warden bases with MacConmara Barrows, the Cut and Gravekeeper's Holdfast to the fore and 7,884 and 8,505 lost in the day. Stlican Shelf falls silent in the last two hours after six, still 18 in the day about Briar and Breaker Town at one Warden to eight Colonial. Godcrofts' Argosa adds nothing in the last two hours. Marban Hollow, Callahan's Passage, the Nevish Line, Gutter, Olavis Wake, Palantine Berm and Pari Peak show no change in six hours, though the Nevish Line still reports more than 5,000 losses a side in the day and Linn Mercy, Stonecradle and the Deadlands post heavy losses without a recorded flip.
